label: ENDPaCF1 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an ENDPaCF1 Type IIS restriction endonuclease-like locus with an inactive Endonuclease III sensing domain that can recognize diverse DNA hypermodifications and protect bacteria from hypermodified phages.
observations: END nuclease phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Type IIS restriction endonuclease-like proteins, iEndoIII domains, Type IIS restriction-modification systems with cognate methyltransferases, Type IV restriction endonuclease systems, DNA hypermodification sensing by itself, phage-encoded END nuclease inhibitors, source database rows naming one ENDPaCF1 model, individual DefenseFinder HMM profiles, and missing DefenseFinder rule rows.
